statement.p: For each of the following vector fields F , decide whether it is conservative or not by computing the appropriate first order partial derivatives. Type in a potential function f (that is, \nabla f = \mathbf{F}) with f(0,0) = 0. If it is not conservative, type N.
A. \mathbf{F} \left( x, y \right) = \left( 16 x - 6 y \right) \mathbf{i} + \left( -6 x+ 12 y\right) \mathbf{j}
C. \mathbf{F} \left( x, y \right) = \left( 8 \sin y \right) \mathbf{i} + \left( -12 y+ 8 x \cos y \right) \mathbf{j}
Note: Your answers should be either expressions of x and y (e.g. 3xy + 2y), or the letter N
